column1: # patchcheck advisory data. Single source of truth for patchcheck.sh and patchcheck.ps1.
# Tab-separated, one rule per line. Use '-' for an empty field.
# runtime  branch  status  fixed  id  source  note
#   branch : PHP/Go = major.minor, Node = major; 'older' / 'newer' are fallbacks for
#            branches below / above every branch listed for that runtime.
#   status : fixed       - patched at >= 'fixed' on this branch
#            eol         - no upstream fix for this branch (vulnerable)
#            unconfirmed - no fix confirmed; needs a manual look (exit code 2)
# See CONTRIBUTING.md before editing: every row needs a source.
# '#@ reviewed <runtime> <branch> <version> <date>' lines (added by the weekly data-review pull request) mean: a person read the
# release notes up to <version> and found no new security fix that needs a row. They only silence the daily REVIEW alert up to
# that version. They never change what patchcheck reports as vulnerable; only the fixed versions in the rows below do.
